substeps.caption: The hatch opens on the powder revolver: five sealed cartridges, 250 % of the build volume when full.
A spent cartridge comes out to be refilled outside; a full one goes in. No open powder.
Hatch shut. The chamber door opens and a 150 mm build plate goes onto the platform.
Door shut; argon purge. See-through: the revolver turns a full cartridge over the feed to the hopper.
The recoater spreads a layer of powder over the plate.
The 200 W fibre laser melts each layer's cross-section.
The platform drops a layer; the recoater spreads fresh powder over it.
The platform drops a layer; the recoater spreads fresh powder over it.
Done: the plate comes out through the door to the MUNPACK station, which depowders it.
1900 mm tall: it stands beside the VLM.
